name: Demas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world: he saw the looseness of the women and told Paul, I have got to go, I have needs. Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia. Those men who were strong in the Lord are some of you.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Demas
cases.charge: Forsaking Paul, having loved this present world
cases.preview: Demas is greeted with Luke in the letter to Colossae (Colossians 4:14) and counted among Paul’s fellowlabourers in the letter to Philemon (Philemon 1:23-24).
